component: RustFlow shared Taylor acceptance and independent-refinement verification; not a Symbolica algebra failure.
scope: High-degree sparse polynomial forcing can vanish at both sampled defect points and lie above both retained Taylor orders.

reproduction.counterexample: y'=epsilon*g(x)*y, y(0)=1; epsilon orders zero and one
reproduction.explanation: All retained Taylor orders below N+1 miss g; endpoint and midpoint g vanish exactly, so all collocation defects and retained tail vanish. Independent order/precision reruns agree on an incorrect answer.

exact_proof: For N=1000, g=2(N+1)(N+2)(N+3)x^N(x-1/2)(x-1), integrate termwise. Integral0..1 g=2(N+1)(N+2)(N+3)*(1/(N+3)-3/(2(N+2))+1/(2(N+1)))=1-N=-999; Symbolica verifies the derivative and integral exactly.
impact: Public transport_epsilon incorrectly returns verified_digits=20, zero comparison errors and one verified checkpoint for epsilon1=0. Agreement between two truncations and endpoint/midpoint defects is insufficient to rule out this aliasing.
historical_benchmark_scope: Recorded comparisons against independent reference values remain separate evidence for those specific examples. This reproducer contradicts generic assurance from refinement agreement alone.
corrective_work: Stage a whole-segment cleared-polynomial residual majorant retaining full source degrees and using native Symbolica polynomial operations; preserve denominator bounds and later add compatible algebraic/root error estimates. Do not substitute extra collocation points or silently lower tolerances.
